health.description: only return rules with this evaluation health: ok, err or unknown

matches.description: label selectors; only return rules whose labels match at least one of them

rule_group.description: only return rules from the rule group with exactly this name

rule_name.description: only return rules with exactly this name

state.description: only return alerting rules in this state: firing, pending or inactive (recording rules are omitted)

type.description: only return rules of this type: alerting or recording
